name: Helix Mono (monospace typeface by HelixDB)
summary: Free monospace typeface for code, data and interfaces: JetBrains Mono NL 2.304 with HelixDB's own glyph edits (angular corners, square-ended r, mirrored g hook, clearly distinct I/l/1). Six weights from ExtraLight to Bold, each with an italic (12 styles), shipped as TTF and WOFF2 for desktop and web.

access.notes: SIL Open Font License 1.1: use, embed and modify freely; do not sell the font files on their own. Based on JetBrains Mono (© 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors).

procedure: Download HelixMono-1.0.zip from the v1.0 release
Desktop: install the files in ttf/ and pick 'Helix Mono' in your editor or terminal
Web: use the woff2/ files with @font-face

verdict.why: Fresh v1.0 (repo and release 11-26), clean OFL license, full zip downloads without signup, 12 styles for code and UI. Derivative of JetBrains Mono rather than a design from scratch, so the gain is mostly stylistic. 757 likes on the launch post.
